method.alignment: same effective class, type code, segment, and byte length

confidence.high: width >= 2 and at least four distinct semantic values
confidence.low: two-value, one-byte, or otherwise collision-prone exact match
confidence.medium: width >= 2 and at least three distinct semantic values

method.correlation: exact all-instance match against 1-, 2-, or 4-byte big-endian encodings of already-decoded scalar fields; varying fields only

policy: Correlations describe serialized Mac resource bytes only. They do not establish Windows ABI layout, inheritance, addresses, vtables, or calling conventions.
